pl-rhizophora-mangle.title: Red Mangrove
pl-rhizophora-mangle.summary: A saltwater tree sold as a seed pod. Planted in sand, rock or a refugium it takes root, can help lower nitrate and phosphate, and grows into a small tree with arching prop roots.
rows: Emergent: roots and lower stem in salt water, leaves in the air
Tree (starts as a long seed pod)
Refugium, sump or open-top tank: push the pod into the sand or wedge it in rock
Moderate: grows arching prop roots that grip sand and rock
Root feeder: takes nutrients from the water and sand around its roots
Tropical and subtropical coasts in both hemispheres
notes: Give it moderate flow and enough light so the roots take hold.
Needs only an occasional trim and wiping salt off the leaves.
